usage: sot-validator report [-h] [--results-file RESULTS_FILE] [--input-dir INPUT_DIR]
                            [--snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                            [--evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME] [--html-dashboard]
                            [--html-output HTML_OUTPUT] [--manifest-file MANIFEST_FILE]
                            [--reconciliation-file RECONCILIATION_FILE]
                            [--port-plan-file PORT_PLAN_FILE] [--parity-file PARITY_FILE]
                            [--ups-health-file UPS_HEALTH_FILE]
                            [--itsm-tickets-file ITSM_TICKETS_FILE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --results-file RESULTS_FILE
                        Path to validation_results.json.
  --input-dir INPUT_DIR
                        Directory containing validation_results.json (and optional snapshots).
  --snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR
                        Directory containing site snapshots for metadata enrichment.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to write validation_report.json, validation_report.csv,
                        validation_summary.md, and remediation_action_plan.json.
  --evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME
                        Optional timestamp override for report generation.
  --html-dashboard      Generate self-contained interactive HTML5 dashboard
                        (validation_dashboard.html).
  --html-output HTML_OUTPUT
                        Optional custom output path for the HTML5 dashboard.
  --manifest-file, --manifest MANIFEST_FILE
                        Optional Phase 2 RemediationApprovalManifest JSON file to embed in the
                        HTML dashboard.
  --reconciliation-file RECONCILIATION_FILE
                        Optional Phase 3 ReconciliationReport JSON file to embed in the HTML
                        dashboard.
  --port-plan-file, --port-plan PORT_PLAN_FILE
                        Optional Phase 4 PortReclamationPlan JSON file to embed in the HTML
                        dashboard.
  --parity-file, --parity-report PARITY_FILE
                        Optional Phase 5 MigrationParityReport JSON file to embed in the HTML
                        dashboard.
  --ups-health-file, --ups-report UPS_HEALTH_FILE
                        Optional Phase 6 UpsFleetHealthReport JSON file to embed in the HTML
                        dashboard.
  --itsm-tickets-file ITSM_TICKETS_FILE
                        Optional Phase 6 ITSM tickets JSON file to embed in the HTML dashboard.
